batch: Phase C1 correction -- fixes my own error: Phase C1's JSON used 'inserts' (additive) for items that should have been 'relocations' (T2 -> destination), so all 20 items landed dual-tagged T2 + their new home instead of leaving T2. T2 means 'excluded from analysis' -- an item just given a real classification should not still carry it. Adds a new 'removals' capability to apply_1598_cluster_batch.py to fix this (soft-deletes the stale T2 row without touching the already-correct new row).
